name: stream-router
description: Control plane kamera dengan MediaMTX ingest/WebRTC/recording dan FFmpeg relay online.

scripts.predev: node scripts/ensure-dev-env.mjs && node scripts/ensure-mediamtx.mjs && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n media,api,web "npm run media:dev" "npm run dev --workspace=@stream-router/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@stream-router/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@stream-router/web && npm run build --workspace=@stream-router/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=@stream-router/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@stream-router/ffmpeg && npm run typecheck --workspace=@stream-router/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@stream-router/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && vitest run packages/ffmpeg/tests apps/api/tests/unit && npm run test --workspace=@stream-router/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && vitest run apps/api/tests/integration
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@stream-router/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@stream-router/ffmpeg
